title: This meeting supersedes a recorded decision

prior_decisions.text: Run the cutover in a single overnight window.

segments.speaker: Karol
segments.text: The single overnight window is too risky.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Two windows, read only first, then the write switch.

segments.speaker: Karol
segments.text: Decided: we split the cutover into two windows. That replaces the single window plan.
